program = '''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    base = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_lines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v == base for v in row) < w / 2]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == base for r in range(h)) < h / 2]
    if len(row_lines) < 2 or len(col_lines) < 2:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    corners = [grid[r][c] for r in row_lines for c in col_lines]
    line_color = Counter(corners).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [[base for _ in range(len(col_lines) - 1)] for _ in range(len(row_lines) - 1)]
    for i in range(len(row_lines) - 1):
        for j in range(len(col_lines) - 1):
            vals = (grid[row_lines[i]][col_lines[j]], grid[row_lines[i]][col_lines[j + 1]],
                    grid[row_lines[i + 1]][col_lines[j]], grid[row_lines[i + 1]][col_lines[j + 1]])
            if vals[0] != line_color and all(v == vals[0] for v in vals):
                out[i][j] = vals[0]

    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(out) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != base]
    if not cells:
        return out
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in cells), max(r for r, _ in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in cells), max(c for _, c in cells)
    return [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in out[r0:r1 + 1]]
'''

path.write_text(program)
